title: TriMet Park and Rides
description:
TriMet park and ride locations. 46 Point features covering [TriMet](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/)'s service district in the Portland, Oregon metropolitan area, published by TriMet as [`tm_parkride`](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/data/tm_parkride.zip) and last updated at the source on June 23, 2026.

This is a cloud-native mirror: the same data as GeoParquet and PMTiles. The GeoParquet keeps TriMet's native EPSG:2913 (NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft)), so lengths and areas are in feet; only the PMTiles are reprojected to WGS84. The original [Shapefile](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/data/tm_parkride.zip), [KML](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/data/tm_parkride.kml) and [metadata page](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/meta_tm_parkride.shtml) are linked as assets, and column descriptions and code lists are TriMet's own, taken from that page.

The [collection README](https://source.coop/cholmes/trimet/park-and-rides/README.md) covers suggested uses, limitations and the full schema.

**Agents:** [`AGENTS.md`](https://source.coop/cholmes/trimet/park-and-rides/AGENTS.md) is the guide written for you — what joins to what and on which column, the quirks that produce silently wrong answers (documented codes that do not appear in the data, columns TriMet's metadata omits, counts that mean different things in different collections), what the coordinate system implies for measurement, and query recipes that have each been run against these files.

visual.title: TriMet Park and Rides (PMTiles)
visual.description: Vector tiles for web display, layer name `park-and-rides`, reprojected to WGS84 as tiles require. Built with tippecanoe keeping every feature at every zoom, so what a map draws matches the GeoParquet exactly.

thumbnail.title: TriMet Park and Rides preview
thumbnail.description: Rendered from this collection's styles/default.json with MapLibre GL Native, over a light basemap. WebP is allowed for thumbnails by spec PR portolan-sdi/portolan-spec#121, which this catalog targets; Portolan 0.1 alone permits only PNG and JPEG.

style.title: TriMet Park and Rides
style.description: The 46 park and ride facilities in TriMet blue. A steady mark size makes this the right style when the question is where the lots are rather than how big they are.

style-by-capacity.title: TriMet Park and Rides by capacity
style-by-capacity.description: Scales each mark by SPACES and ramps its color with it, over a range that runs from small lots up to the 750-space Clackamas Town Center garage. Area, not radius, tracks capacity, so a lot that looks twice as big holds roughly twice as many cars. The whole system holds 12,501 spaces.

style-by-owner.title: TriMet Park and Rides by ownership
style-by-owner.description: Separates the 32 TriMet-owned lots from the 14 shared-use facilities. The distinction matters in practice: shared lots are much smaller, 929 spaces between them against 11,572 in the TriMet-owned lots, and their availability depends on an agreement with the property owner.

style-labeled.title: TriMet Park and Rides with names and capacity
style-labeled.description: Capacity-scaled marks labeled with the facility name and its space count, so a reader can identify a specific lot without clicking it.

source_shapefile.title: TriMet Park and Rides — original TriMet Shapefile
source_shapefile.description: TriMet's own distribution of `tm_parkride`, in NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft). This is the file this collection was built from. Size and checksum are of what TriMet served at the sync time recorded in `updated`.
